Lina (Mktg): Morning — dashboard shows ~95 unassigned EMEA leads between 23:00-05:00 UTC. spikes in DE/FR.
Raj - SalesOps: thanks for flagging. quick check: enrichment timeouts or owner-rule logic?
Marcus CS: enrichment calls returned rate-limited 429s for a bunch of records. owner rule depends on contact.segment and company.size, so it skipped.
Tina Eng: our enrichment queue uses a small burst capacity overnight; we intentionally downscale to reduce cost. can increase but prefer a safe fallback.
Lina (Mktg): proposal: introduce a short timebox fallback that assigns leads to a zonal night-pool after N minutes to avoid unowned leads, then let enrichment reassign.
Raj - SalesOps: agree. suggest timebox = 10 minutes (shorter than usual) and separate pools by segment: emea-night-enterprise, emea-night-smb. add property inbound_fallback=true.
Marcus CS: add a TTL tag so we can filter analytics and exclude fallback-assigned leads from conversion velocity metrics until validated.
Tina Eng: reassign webhook should be idempotent. when enrichment returns, call our internal endpoint to swap owner: POST /internal/lead/reassign { contact_id, real_owner, source: "enrichment" }. include prev_owner meta.
Raj - SalesOps: HubSpot workflow draft: Delay 10m -> If owner IS_EMPTY AND timezone IN EMEA AND contact.created_at BETWEEN 22:00-06:00 UTC -> Set owner = {{segment_based_pool}}; Set property inbound_fallback = true; Set property fallback_ts = {{now}}.
Lina (Mktg): can we also create an SLA rule: escalate if still fallback after 2h — page SDR lead + create ticket in handoff queue? want to avoid permanent fallbacks.
Marcus CS: yep. And add a daily report of fallback->real_owner reassignment rates and manual interventions.
Tina Eng: ops note: we won't change enrichment throttle for now. implementing fallback keeps load stable. If fallbacks spike >5% for 3h, auto-trigger a temporary enrichment scale-up.
Raj - SalesOps: rollout plan: HS sandbox workflow, SFDC flow mirror, UK canary for 48h, dashboards: unassigned_count, fallback_assign_rate, time_to_real_owner, fallback_exclude_conversions.
HubSpot Enrich Bot: webhook enq-2026-06-02-114 delivered; status 202 queued.
Lina (Mktg): I'll update the SDR playbook with guidance for night-pool leads and schedule a 1-week retrospective after canary.
Raj - SalesOps: posting the HubSpot JSON for review in #marketing in 10m. ping me for access. :eyes: 
Marcus CS: sounds good. thumbs up.
